initialize_PyTorchDistBackend: initialize a PyTorchDistBackend instance with bootstrap_info and commsParams to set up distributed training
run_all_reduce_collective: run an all_reduce collective operation with optional quantization on float32 tensors across ranks
run_all_to_all_collective: run an all_to_all collective operation with optional quantization and batched embedding table support
run_barrier_sync: run a barrier synchronization across all ranks with optional NCCL device ID specification
run_benchmark_comms: run a communication benchmark using benchmark_comms with a benchTime callback and commsParams configuration
